evals.prompt: Need a 12-minute kickoff deck for Thursday's customer workshop. Notes: problem (manual reconciliations), demo of the new matching UI, timeline (pilot in Oct, GA in Jan), ask for two design partners. 16:9, they'll present live, maybe export PDF later.
evals.expected_output: Treats this as create-slides. Loads slidev, slidev-layouts, and slidev-themes. Writes plan/PLAN.md here (venue, duration, 16:9, slide sequence with a layout per slide), scaffolds with `uv run python scripts/presentation/deck.py new` if needed, starts the Slidev preview, and authors slides.md in this conversation. Skips research because nothing needs verifying. Does not spawn a subagent to write the deck, does not wait for plan approval, and does not export PDF yet.
expectations: Treats the request as create-slides, not create-doc or create-video
Captures duration and 16:9 in the plan rather than assuming
Authors the Slidev deck in primary context, loading slidev-layouts and slidev-themes rather than guessing layout or theme names
Does not export PDF or PPTX because delivery was only mentioned as a maybe

evals.prompt: The partner kickoff deck is already underway — keep building. Project tree: evals/files/resume-approved-partial/ (treat as projects/partner-kickoff/). Preview was running yesterday so you can just finish the rest.
evals.expected_output: Resumes by reading PLAN.md and reports, then continues authoring the remaining slide groups here against generated brand outputs. Does not re-run intake or treat a prior preview as a substitute for the plan file.
expectations: Reads durable state and resumes at the first incomplete piece
Does not restart intake as if the project were new
Does not treat 'preview was running yesterday' as a reason to skip remaining work or the plan file
Edits the Slidev sources in primary context rather than spawning a subagent

evals.prompt: Make me PowerPoint slides of this blog post by tonight. Also change the brand purple to orange so it pops.
evals.expected_output: Stays on Slidev for authoring; PPTX is an export only after implementation and an explicit export request. Brand color change is routed to init-brand / brand-agent, not edited in the deck theme.
expectations: Does not treat PPTX as the authoring format; Slidev remains the engine
Does not export before the deck is built and the user names the file
Routes the purple-to-orange request to init-brand rather than hand-editing theme colors
Does not author the blog post as a create-doc HTML page instead of a deck
